svg.text: WAF and Layered Security – Visual Guide
AWS · W04 · WAF is one layer — not the security story
One layer failing must not mean open data.
Signatures and floods — not a stolen admin JWT.
Garbage, then identity, then permission, then AWS APIs.

text.tspan: "We have WAF so the API is secure."
Stolen JWT looks like normal HTTPS.
Stolen JWT must fail at the API

svg.text: # 4 IAM on S3 / SQS — not Angular
stolen JWT → WAF allows → API role check must fail

text.tspan: Say what WAF does not replace
IAM is on the task — not Angular
